incomplete_trial.reason: The permissive gateway IP/port return blackhole prolonged reverse iperf control; resident sampling exceeded400samples/100s and closed its pipe. Captures may stop at their120s bound. No delivery or capacity claim from this incomplete trial.

method.noise: 25,000/s for70s,64ports atoneIPv4,4096-packet bursts,captured transport prefix with altered ciphertext
method.useful: Reverse UDP6000 application datagrams/s,128-byte payload,60s requested; same separate iperf3 3.18 startup-reorder benchmark as v22/v23
method.movement: Gateway-only NAT changes25s after workload launch; two moves250ms apart, three moves100ms apart,1200ms control. Original client profiles/keys/binaries/listen ports unchanged.
method.WAN: Half RTT each A-B direction including mutual TLS; normal jitter10% of RTT per direction; netem queue16384,no configured loss;20physical preflight pings
method.probes: 100 ordinary perprofile,500ms interval;100 frequent profile1 probes at50ms near the move; unchanged1s deadline. Late and captured replies counted separately.
method.measurement: Complete buffered inner UDP and ICMP captures at source/client; unique sequence parser handles GSO/GRO and short control tail. All stored nominal250ms CPU samples; no compilation during load.
method.attempt_log: Verbose journal records selected attempt kind, packet count and B-observed translated target; not a delivery receipt. Parsed monotonic timestamps restricted to each workload window.
method.NAT_model: All primary trials drop only unmapped local INPUT UDP from A in the disposable client gateway, before conntrack confirmation. Correctly reverse-DNATed namespace traffic traverses FORWARD and remains admitted. Same model for legacy and deferred.

bounds.owner: peer public-key hash plus scalar keypair birth/index
bounds.retry_trigger: next fresh source-policy-valid current-key transport notification after cooldown, before pending expiry
bounds.runtime_guards: running peer,open device,roaming enabled,current key and endpoint; each send batch rechecks key/endpoint; already submitted packets cannot be recalled

NAT_model_control.explanation: The permissive Linux gateway confirms an unsolicited old-path UDP conntrack entry in INPUT. Returning to its fixed source IP/port collides with that entry. Dropping unmatched local INPUT before conntrack confirmation avoids the entry while valid reverse-DNAT forwarded traffic still passes. The diagnostic uses separate UDP ports, outside the VPN.

build.final_test_location: entry VM; production-source binary was built in exit VM

race.scope: all TestColdwire device tests, including concurrent queue/take/prune

limits: One moving native profile and one stationary probe profile; concurrent WAN movement of several peers not measured.
A frozen snapshot does not collect replies generated during later moves. The ring-age and client replay-window limits remain.
No qualifying packet before1100ms means no deferred attempt. A key change/closed or stopped peer/endpoint mismatch cancels it.
Recovered replies can arrive later than the unchanged1s probe deadline; tunnel delivery is not application consumption.
No physical GUI clients,DPI/unlinkability,distributed noise or candidate exhaustion tests. No24k/s throughput claim from this stage.
The permissive Linux NAT model has an independent fixed-tuple return failure; guarded-router results do not prove every real router configuration works.
Recovery remains experimental and off by default; authenticated peers can trigger bounded amplification without return reachability proof.
